name: site-footer
title: Three-Column Site Footer
locked: headings here are h3 (footer is low in the document outline — never h1/h2)
site-title uses level:0 (renders as a non-heading span, correct for footer chrome)

validTemplates: ALL — footer is a template part shared across templates
compositionRules.isTemplatePart: in a real theme this becomes parts/footer.html referenced by every template

notes: core/navigation references a wp_navigation entity (a menu) — the assembler must either create a default Navigation menu or the block renders empty. This is a site-data dependency the IR must flag, not just markup. social-link 'service' is an enum the validator should check against core's known services. Footer headings are h3: the document-outline rule (one h1 in hero, h2 for sections, h3 for sub-sections) is a cross-pattern invariant the assembler enforces, not something any single pattern can guarantee alone.
